blocks.text: Shofar. Sins are annulled and slavery is lifted and works are restored through the embracing sound of the Shofar. Destroy and cast away the realm of Seir, remember its transgression at the reverberating sound of the Shofar. Let the gates of the city sink and disappear, let fright overcome great and small at the roaring sound of the Shofar. Threefold miraculous signs, three hundred horns set up a loud lament in Midian at the accompanying sound of the Shofar. Israel’s hosts rejoiced at witnessing the miracles when the Creator showed His might through the sweet sound of the Shofar. A slender voice descended upon earth, there were threefold sounds of thunder at the Revelation when sounds were given on the Shofar. A threefold sound of the horn will I blow this day as a symbol of the threefold call of the Shofar (at the redemption) that will one day resound from the future Shofar. I pray to heaven and my eyes are lifted up that I may be allowed to see the gathering of the exiles at the loud sound of the Shofar.
